notes.title: My Name is Mayo 3 is out!
notes.content:
The third, the myth, the legend... the end of an era. Mayo will meet the ultimate destiny in this last journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11634242/15021fbbeef119bff8a241ab25e58966b49196c5.png[/img]

It’s time to get down and groovy with Mayo once again, as we release a nifty end to the trilogy nobody asked for! 

My Name is Mayo 3 is out and about! So uncover the weird stories, click the jar, and (literally) walk along Mayo’s toughest journey. Maybe you’ll learn from it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1779460/My_Name_is_Mayo_3/

Once again, we’re very thankful for your love of Mayonnaise!

Cheers,
Sean Callaghan
Community Manager Sage

notes.title: My Name is Mayo 2

In a world... where Mayonnaise is all but forgotten, this sole sequel could rekindle the flames of its former glory... Huh? Too much of a dramatic kickoff you say? You won't think that when you play the new game!

That's right, the Team at Green Lava released a sequel for My Name is Mayo! Give it a shot, if you wanna go for another round of clicking mayonnaise around. This new game now has some mini games, a collectable album, good old mayonnaise stories, hidden secrets and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1437340/My_Name_is_Mayo_2/

Thank y'all for being part of this, this coudlnt be possible without the support on this title.

Cheers,

notes.title: Green Lava's 10th Anniversary!
notes.content:
Hey y’all,
We still can’t believe it, but this week Green Lava Studios is turning a decade old! From the deepest crevices of our souls and hearts, we are thankful with everyone, every single player, for supporting our work!

As part of this celebration, all our games are on sale! Give ‘em a look here:
https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Green%20Lava%20Studios

Once again, this wouldn’t be possible without you all. The team is working on new, weird games and we will definitely let you know of our plans soon; we can’t wait to reveal what the future holds for our little studio. Alongside copious amounts of coffee, you all are the fuel for these projects!

Finally, we want to give special thanks to Steam, for giving us the opportunity to distribute our games worldwide from sunny Costa Rica. 

Cheers and hugs,
The Green Lava Team

notes.title: Update time! The leaderboards are in!
notes.content:
As promised with our last update, we've implemented online leaderboards for the recent My Name is Mayo Cupcake Update.

Just hit [b]Right Click[/b] until the game starts; then, when you lose, you can check out the leaderboards by pressing [b]L[/b]  (L stands for leaderboards)! And BOOM, you’ll see who’s the fly-killing master. 

Those of you who feel like a hardcore cupcake, can now duke it out with the highest fly-swatting scores you can possibly muster.

And once again, thanks for reading. We wish y’all have fun! 

-  Sean Callaghan
The one and only PR Manager

notes.title: Let’s Talk: The Mini Game Update Fiasco Extravaganza
notes.content:
Hello y’all!

First of all, thank you for reading this, it will be a wild ride!

Ok, for starters, I wanted to clear up a li’l bit what the team meant to do with the update. 

So, we made a small update to [i]My Name is Mayo[/i] in the day we launched [i]Mr. Massagy[/i]: You could use the disembodied finger from that game. We made it in order to celebrate that launch as a fun gig, no achievements were added and Mayo was a dateable character inside [i]Mr. Massagy[/i]. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11634242/aee07a415ebede5468566a5824c04c76f18986d5.jpg[/img]

Similarly, with the launch of [i]Birdcakes[/i], we wanted to put a little, meaningful reference by adding Mayo as an in-game item (actually, it’s a very important item). And viceversa, do a little mini-game inside [i]My Name is Mayo[/i], and add a brand new achievement along with it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11634242/582930f39b0580b96b83e6f37ee3db906f6831a4.jpg[/img]

But we ultimately miscalculated by adding a hard, shooter-like achievement inside a clicker game; and if you think about it, that’s just not cool. We apologize for that tasteless achievement, we honestly didn't see it. We’re happy some of you liked it, but it just wasn’t the greatest of decisions. And as a result, the achievement is now removed.

Green Lava Studios wishes to improve their development capabilities and maybe someday, create something bigger than our own Fenix Rage (Fenix Furia). But hey, life gets in the way, like with everyone else, and Green Lava just don’t want to self-fund future work with “[i]My Name is Mustard[/i]” or something.

[h1]To Recap:[/h1] The little cupcake minigame in My Name is Mayo was just meant to be a fun distraction, but it didn’t quite land; and we gladly accept that. The big question here is (and this is where *you* guys come in): [b] what should be done with this mini-game?[/b] Now that the new achievement is gone, it’s a little bit pointless. The devs are thinking about linking it to a leaderboard or something, but we want to take your suggestions.

[h1]TL;DR:[/h1] We thought the minigame would be fitting, it wasn’t really. Sorry about that. We wanna make something else out of it with your suggestions.

[h1]To end this:[/h1] Birdcakes took a while to make and it wouldn't have been possible without the attention all of you gave to My Name is Mayo. We are very thankful to this community, and it gives us motivation to keep making more stuff and things.

Cheers,
Sean Callaghan
The PR manager that Green Lava needs, but not the one they need right now... or however it goes.

notes.title: Birdcakes Mini-Game!
notes.content:
[i]“One of the greatest gifts you can give to anyone is the gift of attention”[/i][b]  - Jim Rohn[/b] 

Guys, of behalf of Green Lava Studios, we will always be grateful with y’all. Tomorrow (May 29th), the team will deliver a new game: Birdcakes. This wouldn't be even remotely possible without all of you. Thank you for supporting our work!

But ok, let’s keep it real, without too much cheesiness. Let’s talk about the update!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11634242/29b90a00acb86e1898351415042ddc0d6673e32c.jpg[/img]

The team decided to make an update with a tiny mini game, straight out of Birdcakes, so that y’all can give it a try! To activate it, you simply right click until you see the mini game. The cool stuff is that you will be able to feel Birdcakes’ gameplay! [strike]AAAAND! You can unlock a new achievement! Just kill 42 flies and that’s it![/strike] Have your keyboards ready.

I hope y’all like it!!

EDIT: We read your thoughts and we took immediate actions. The extra achievement was removed, we thought it was going to be a good idea for you guys but we were definitely wrong. Our apologies for the confusion! We are extremely grateful for your support.

Peace!
Sean Callaghan
PR Manager or summin’...
